text:
Jules (CSM): Morning everyone — kicking off NewHorizon Freight onboarding. Short goals: connect their app to Redwood hosted inference, enable SSO (Okta), forward generation audit logs to their ELK, and run a 30-day pilot (target 4k tokens/day). Need stakeholders, concrete timeline, and success criteria.
Arun (Solutions Eng): I can own the infra integration and test harness. Suggest 1-week discovery, 2-week integration, 30-day pilot. Will validate latency at expected qps.
Maya (Onboard PM): Ill make a milestone tracker and weekly check-ins. Whos the NewHorizon IAM and who manages ELK ingestion?
Sam (NewHorizon IT): Sam here. IAM is handled by our platform team (Rita). ELK ingest is on Ops (Ben). We can allocate a couple hours/week for integration.
Lee (Security): Note NewHorizon handles user PII for shipment tracking. Need SOC2 attestation + dataflow diagram + encryption proof before prod. Ill send a short checklist.
Ivy (Success Ops): Ill prepare enablement materials: API quickstart, sample prompt pack, acceptance tests, and pilot runbook with health metrics.
Jules (CSM): Draft success criteria: 1) SSO via SAML with test user, 2) Audit events visible in NewHorizon ELK for generate calls, 3) Integration acceptance tests >=95% on critical prompts, 4) Pilot 95th pctl latency <400ms, 5) No P0 incidents for 7 consecutive days. Additions?
Arun (Solutions Eng): Add: output-stability checks for top-20 prompts + simple curl smoke example for their infra team:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-micro","input":"ping"}'
```
Maya (Onboard PM): Proposed workshop times: Tue 09:30 PT or Thu 14:00 PT. Ill block 45m and capture action items.
Sam (NewHorizon IT): Tue 09:30 PT works. Rita and Ben will join.
calendar-bot: Event created for "NewHorizon Freight  Onboarding Kickoff" Tue 09:30-10:15 PT. Attendees: Jules, Arun, Maya, Lee, Sam, Rita, Ben. :calendar:
Jules (CSM): Risks: if SOC2 or SSO delays push >45 days we escalate as renewal risk. Action items: Arun -> integration guide draft (3 business days), Lee -> security checklist (48h), Maya -> milestone tracker + invites (done), Ivy -> enablement pack (EOD).
Arun (Solutions Eng): Will upload playbook draft + test harness link here by EOD.
Lee (Security): Checklist sent to Sam. Please attach dataflow diagram when you can.
Sam (NewHorizon IT): Got it. Will share Okta metadata and ELK index info during the workshop.
Jules (CSM): Great. Ill run weekly pilot health calls and collect feedback. If pilot demonstrates value early, well loop in Renewals mid-pilot to discuss terms. :rocket:
